task.summary: Default task
DB diff script is runnable from npm and fixed the wrong port check method.
Ran prisma migrate to updated db to new schema
Pages can now be edited and saved Also added slugs to seeding scripts
Changed some of the navigation labels
Created delete route
The page content is now more strictly validated, because we now transform the slug on multiple levels.
Puck editor is now full height for pages
The admin sidebar is now hidden for the page mutation routes.
Added new logo and favicon
Double checked and fixed the meta tags where applicable, so now regular pages have their custom meta tags back.
Implemented a basic upload handler for images
Added some test routes for checking the image upload. Also improved it so the DX is a bit better.
Fixed typo
Configured Kubernetes templates with the correct bucket name and credentials based on the deployment environment
Added missing LoginFormComponent translations to login route
Added Prisma migrations script for prod and dev database deploys, in preparation for when we switch over to managed databases.
Created a Nav menu component that lists a navigation menu, and created the route for the menu manager
Extended Plop generator to allow the selection of tags and categories
Created base component for the MenuEditor
We now have a very rudimentary draggable menu editor interface
MenuEditor now works as component that can be previewed.
We now have a basic workflow for editing the menu
Swapped navigation menu out for the actual header (in demo mode), which also meant we can load the dynamic header on the site itself. Also swapped orientation on the manage menu page
Extracted save action and implemented it on the page level, just like Cancel.
Semantically fixed db migrations workflow
Smaller changes and improvements so that we can work with illustrations in Puck
Event model is amended with organiser and image fields which are seeded and shown in UI.
Added box and line illustrations, and created the hand drawn box component
Content summaries
Opened project in a new editor with lots of catching up from PHPStorm. Also configured Storybook with more devices and a proxy
Updated Heading component with extra props, and improved the italic uppercase logic
Some Storybook/docs improvements
Added props to the hand drawn box component
Created a post it note component
Improved the upcoming events
Installed and configured the container query plugin for Tailwind
Some layout improvements to the upcoming events block
Created a Puck block of the upcoming events component, which also needed React Query, an api endpoint and a loader
Add Upcoming Events translations and fixed UpcomingEventsBlock component suspense error
Add BackgroundBlock component and update title structure in page configuration
Updated node version and updated all dependencies that have no major version update. Then update Puck to 0.20 in preparation for 0.21
Updated Puck to 0.21 and refactored all imports and usePuck calls
Started refactoring the rich text editor component by dropping tinymce and picking Puck's own shipped editor
Refactor root props structure and add migration support for title visibility
Fixed lint errors and returned editor header in Puck overrides so that we could have our functionality back
Ran lint
